list.name: cohort_type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT type FROM integrations.cohorts ORDER BY type

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.value AS stage, COUNT(uc.user_telegram_id) AS count
FROM integrations.cohorts c
JOIN integrations.user_cohorts uc ON uc.cohort_id = c.id
WHERE c.type = '$cohort_type'
  AND LOWER(c.value) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive', 'hold')
GROUP BY c.value
ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(first_tr.created_at, '1d', 0) AS time,
  first_tr.new_value AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_telegram_id, new_value)
    user_telegram_id,
    new_value,
    created_at
  FROM integrations.stage_transitions
  WHERE cohort_type = '$cohort_type'
    AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
    AND LOWER(new_value) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive', 'hold')
  ORDER BY user_telegram_id, new_value, created_at
) first_tr
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Конверсия (FROM → TO)

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE trans_pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT old_value, new_value
  FROM integrations.stage_transitions
  WHERE cohort_type = '$cohort_type'
    AND created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND old_value IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(old_value) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive', 'hold')
    AND LOWER(new_value) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive', 'hold')
),
dominant_edges AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN fwd.old_value < fwd.new_value OR bwd.old_value IS NULL
      THEN fwd.old_value ELSE fwd.new_value END AS src,
    CASE WHEN fwd.old_value < fwd.new_value OR bwd.old_value IS NULL
      THEN fwd.new_value ELSE fwd.old_value END AS dst
  FROM trans_pairs fwd
  LEFT JOIN trans_pairs bwd
    ON bwd.old_value = fwd.new_value AND bwd.new_value = fwd.old_value
  WHERE fwd.old_value < fwd.new_value OR bwd.old_value IS NULL
),
root AS (
  SELECT src AS stage
  FROM dominant_edges
  GROUP BY src
  ORDER BY
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dominant_edges de2 WHERE de2.dst = dominant_edges.src) ASC,
    COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
bfs(stage, depth) AS (
  SELECT stage, 0 FROM root
  UNION
  SELECT e.dst, b.depth + 1
  FROM bfs b
  JOIN dominant_edges e ON e.src = b.stage
  WHERE b.depth < 20
),
depths AS (
  SELECT stage, MIN(depth) AS depth FROM bfs GROUP BY stage
),
positions AS (
  SELECT
    stage,
    depth * 250.0 AS x,
    (
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY depth ORDER BY stage) - 1
      - (COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY depth) - 1) / 2.0
    ) * 120.0 AS y
  FROM depths
),
orphans AS (
  SELECT
    c.value AS stage,
    (COALESCE((SELECT MAX(depth) FROM depths), 0) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.value)) * 250.0 AS x,
    0.0 AS y
  FROM integrations.cohorts c
  WHERE c.type = '$cohort_type'
    AND LOWER(c.value) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive', 'hold')
    AND c.value NOT IN (SELECT stage FROM depths)
),
all_positions AS (
  SELECT stage, x, y FROM positions
  UNION ALL
  SELECT stage, x, y FROM orphans
)
SELECT
  c.value AS id,
  c.value AS title,
  COUNT(DISTINCT uc.user_telegram_id)::bigint AS mainStat,
  COALESCE(ap.x, 0.0)::float AS x,
  COALESCE(ap.y, 0.0)::float AS y
FROM integrations.cohorts c
JOIN integrations.user_cohorts uc ON uc.cohort_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN all_positions ap ON ap.stage = c.value
WHERE c.type = '$cohort_type'
  AND LOWER(c.value) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive', 'hold')
GROUP BY c.value, ap.x, ap.y

WITH trans AS (
  SELECT old_value, new_value, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM integrations.stage_transitions
  WHERE cohort_type = '$cohort_type'
    AND created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND old_value IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(old_value) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive', 'hold')
    AND LOWER(new_value) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive', 'hold')
  GROUP BY old_value, new_value
),
totals AS (
  SELECT old_value, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM trans GROUP BY old_value
)
SELECT
  LEAST(fwd.old_value, fwd.new_value) || '->' || GREATEST(fwd.old_value, fwd.new_value) AS id,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(fwd.cnt,0) >= COALESCE(bwd.cnt,0)
    THEN fwd.old_value ELSE fwd.new_value END AS source,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(fwd.cnt,0) >= COALESCE(bwd.cnt,0)
    THEN fwd.new_value ELSE fwd.old_value END AS target,
  GREATEST(COALESCE(fwd.cnt,0), COALESCE(bwd.cnt,0))::bigint AS mainStat,
  ROUND(
    GREATEST(COALESCE(fwd.cnt,0), COALESCE(bwd.cnt,0))::numeric
    / NULLIF(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(fwd.cnt,0) >= COALESCE(bwd.cnt,0)
          THEN tf.total ELSE tb.total END,
        0
      ) * 100, 1
  ) AS secondaryStat
FROM trans fwd
LEFT JOIN trans bwd ON bwd.old_value = fwd.new_value AND bwd.new_value = fwd.old_value
LEFT JOIN totals tf ON tf.old_value = fwd.old_value
LEFT JOIN totals tb ON tb.old_value = fwd.new_value
WHERE fwd.old_value < fwd.new_value OR bwd.old_value IS NULL

panels.description:
Число в узле — сколько человек сейчас на стадии.
Верхнее число на ребре — количество переходов между стадиями за период.
Нижнее число на ребре — % от всех ушедших с исходной стадии.

targets.rawSql:
WITH real_transitions AS (
  SELECT
    user_telegram_id,
    old_value,
    new_value,
    created_at
  FROM integrations.stage_transitions
  WHERE cohort_type = '$cohort_type'
    AND (old_value IS NULL OR new_value <> old_value)
),
stage_periods AS (
  SELECT
    user_telegram_id,
    new_value AS stage,
    created_at AS started_at,
    LEAD(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY user_telegram_id ORDER BY created_at) AS ended_at,
    LEAD(new_value) OVER (PARTITION BY user_telegram_id ORDER BY created_at) AS next_stage
  FROM real_transitions
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    stage,
    ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ended_at - started_at)) / 86400)
          FILTER (WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL
                    AND next_stage IS NOT NULL
                    AND next_stage <> stage
                    AND ended_at >= $__timeFrom()
                    AND ended_at <  $__timeTo())::numeric, 1) AS "Вышли в период",
    ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(ended_at, NOW()) - started_at)) / 86400)
          FILTER (WHERE ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= $__timeTo())::numeric, 1) AS "Ещё на стадии"
  FROM stage_periods
  WHERE LOWER(stage) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive', 'hold', 'probationary period')
  GROUP BY stage
)
SELECT stage, "Вышли в период", "Ещё на стадии"
FROM agg
WHERE "Вышли в период" IS NOT NULL OR "Ещё на стадии" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY GREATEST(COALESCE("Вышли в период", 0), COALESCE("Ещё на стадии", 0)) DESC
